additional_concerns: These assessments concern the supplied source and declared representation. No Fund-specific evidence, executable implementation or runtime results are supplied; the labels do not establish a classification for any actual Fund.

Footnote 7 expressly places the holistic discretionary assessment below 50% of NAV. The representation does not expressly guard the designation branch with a below-threshold condition. For consistent known Boolean inputs, threshold OR designation and threshold OR (NOT threshold AND designation) give the same classification result. Thus the missing guard is a source-context omission, not an established output defect; it must not imply that the automatic route requires a separate SFC decision.

The global conflict rule blocks evaluation even when an independently established route would suffice. For example, a conflict about designation can block a known at-least-50% threshold result. This is an additional evidentiary restriction imposed by the runtime, not a condition stated by the circular. Whether it is an intended operational safeguard remains unresolved.

The circular does not supply exposure measurement, look-through, valuation, netting or aggregation methods in the retained text. The representation acknowledges that these are unresolved input judgments. If applying the rule requires further measurement authority, that authority is missing and must be identified; no supplied dependency ID can presently be matched to it.

An assessment relying on the discretionary route needs the actual Fund-specific SFC designation and evidence of its temporal applicability. Those materials are not supplied. A false designation input likewise requires adequate evidence; an unsearched history cannot establish absence. No identifiable dependency ID for such materials is provided.

The supplied text does not establish effective dates, designation persistence or later amendments. Applying this rule at a particular time requires those matters to be resolved where material. The mere possibility of later updates does not establish that an update exists.

The three supplied external dependency IDs all have null source_hash values and no descriptions identifying their authorities. None can be marked AVAILABLE or reliably assigned to a particular missing authority. All pair-level NONE_DECLARED assessments concern support for the narrow claims, not completeness of evidence for a Fund-specific determination.

Additional external authorities expressly referenced by the retained source but not supplied with identifiable mappings are UT Code section 7.3; the LAF circular refNo=25EC9; Code of Conduct paragraph 5.5; Chapter 6 of the Guidelines on Online Distribution and Advisory Platforms and relevant FAQs; the internal product-approval circular refNo=16EC11; and the cited advertising guidelines. Their absence does not defeat claims stated directly in this circular, but it prevents assessment of their full incorporated requirements.

Footnote 1 states a 15% limit on direct private-asset investments or exposures under UT Code section 7.3. That separate investment restriction must not be substituted for the 50% aggregate classification threshold, used to cap observed exposure artificially, or treated as permission for all exposures below 50%. Overall investment-limit compliance is outside this question.

Footnote 6 excludes a category of assessed Funds. It does not exclude every listed closed-ended holding from indirect exposure. In particular, the BDC description must not be conflated with the LAF exclusion.

The factors also include home-regulator distribution restrictions, requirements or conditions under unit d4148dd852cee.u28.4505. These are not represented as executable factor assessments. Like the listed asset and Fund characteristics, they inform SFC discretion and do not themselves substitute for an actual designation.

The consultation statement is supported as encouragement. Its OBLIGATION/SHOULD metadata would overstate the source if a downstream process treated it as a mandatory consultation condition or an independent classification trigger.

A false classification result does not establish overall compliance, permission to distribute without other requirements, or absence of classification under another regime. OUT_OF_SCOPE for a LAF likewise does not establish that the Fund is non-complex under its separate regime.

The discretionary-factor and definition omissions are upstream assessment boundaries, not automatic instructions to add predicates to the Boolean rule. Their proper treatment depends on whether a separate, adequately supported input-assessment process exists.
